name: Harp
overview: The harp, a stringed instrument introduced by Jubal as the father of those who handle it (Genesis 4:21), plays a significant role in biblical worship and celebration. It is used to accompany singing and rejoicing, as seen in Nehemiah during the dedication of Jerusalem's walls (Nehemiah 12:27) and in festive dancing (Job 21:11-12). The instrument is closely associated with the music of David and the Levites, highlighting its importance in both personal and national expressions of praise (Nehemiah 12:36).
